operations.summary: Add nullable processed_at column before application starts writing it
Backfill processed_at in bounded batches after application rollout

preApply: Confirm processed_at does not already exist
Record order row count and null-state baseline
postApply: Confirm column exists with expected type and nullability
Run application smoke tests against migrated schema
compatibility: Old application version ignores the nullable new column
New application version can run before backfill completes
reconciliation: Backfilled rows + intentionally unprocessed rows equals source row count

steps: Disable writes to processed_at with feature configuration if application behavior is incorrect
Deploy corrected application or backfill logic
Do not drop the new column during the compatibility window
